* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Muskingum River at and near
McConnelsville is expected this afternoon and evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

The Cottonwood Burn Scar in...
West Central Piute County in central Utah...

* Until 415 PM MDT.

properties.description:

estimated totals of 4 to 10 inches with a major portion of that
falling this afternoon. Of note, 3hr annual return intervals have
been up to 200 years or more across the warned area this afternoon.
While the heavy rainfall has subsided, it is likely that low water
crossings, fields, and small streams will remain flooded through the
remainder of the afternoon.

* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...A portion of northern Indiana, including the following
counties, Cass IN, Fulton IN, Grant, La Porte, Marshall, Miami,
Pulaski, Starke, Wabash and White.

* WHEN...Until 530 PM EDT /430 PM CDT/.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings are inundated with water and may not be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 217 PM EDT /117 PM CDT/, emergency management reported
heavy rain in the warned area due to thunderstorms. Flooding
is ongoing or expected to begin shortly. Between 3 and 6
inches or more of rain have fallen this afternoon.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are possible in
the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Logansport, Peru, Rochester, Winamac, Grissom Afb, North
Judson, Walton, Bunker Hill, Francesville, La Fontaine, Royal
Center, Medaryville, Mexico, Lincoln, Wells, Pulaski, Miami,
